description: A layout with plot settings in millimetres: ISO A3 (420 by 297), landscape rotation code 1, plot scale 1:50, margins 5, 6, 7 and 8 mm (left, bottom, right, top), plot origin (10, 12) mm, lineweights not printed and the monochrome.ctb style table named. One viewport and a paper-space border line. Every plot setting has to survive.
